reviews.comment: Jones is a great professor who actually made Endo an interesting subject for me. There are 4 exams but the lowest is dropped, so you can just take 3 if you're doing good.  As long as you study the slides, the exams are easy and they're slightly curved. He always gives away a few of the FRQs and there's extra credit if you need it. Highly recommend.

Dr. Jones really tried his best to make Endo interesting but I didn't really like it. No final, no hw, only 4 exams, he drops the lowest, also curve an 88 avg to an A so try to do well on the first 3 exams. He clearly list the slide tested beforehand, and exams are half MC and FRQ. Overall, passionate prof but not an enjoyable class for me.
reviews.ratingTags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Jones is definitely one of the top profs I've taken! He makes the material so much easier to understand and genuinely wants to see his students succeed. The entire grade is 4 exams with the lowest being dropped and one extra credit opportunity but it is a very doable class. So glad I took him!

Dr. Jones was awesome and the content in this class was so much fun to learn! He truly makes endocrinology easier to grasp, despite it being very concept heavy and specific. He's very generous and always tells us which slides to focus on for the exams throughout the semester. Extra credit is offered and there are curves!

Lectures move quick, but he's always willing to explain things again. Graded on four exams, lowest dropped. Makes it very clear what you need to know, and technically the slides have everything that'll be on the exams, but definitely show up to lecture because it makes the slides WAY easier to digest. Great prof, really interesting class.
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Test heavy--Graded by few things
